basic_info.description: Spectacular Top Floor Hayes Valley Condo!  This bright and airy top-floor flat in the heart of Hayes Valley is bathed in natural light entering from large, well-placed skylights, blending classic charm with modern updates. Beautifully refinished softwood floors lead to a spacious living room with a large closet, a primary bedroom with ample storage, and a second bedroom. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, dishwasher, and stunning views of City Hall. A nicely renovated bathroom and in-unit washer/dryer add to the home's convenience. Just blocks from Trader Joe's, Suppenkuche, Petit Crenn, and more, this exceptional home offers the best of city living in a prime location.
